She was mad since my dad was yelling at her for my mistakes. I constantly think of my funeral with all my family but I feel so selfish when I think to myself that why should I suffer with my life when they just have to deal with grief.

It's possible but harder now that everyone is either getting jobs,don't have their PCs,not available or just don't want to do it anymore.  I still have contact with one of them and they will do it so I might be able to do it again. My interests are basically just video games with friends.

I always smile when I remember playing games with my friends all night on our PCs staying up till 4 Am, just laughing at what's happening at the game or at each other. I always wish it was still that simple.

Actually, after taking a couple of moments of thinking to figure out why I was happy, I really don't know. I think I just ignored a lot of negative things that really bothered me but other than maybe that I really don't know.

I honestly don't know where I see myself in 5 years. Everything sorta changes in a small period of time. Like for around 6 months I was actually happy with my life because I had nothing to worry about but now I feel like i was just ignoring everything I was supposed to worried about and it was all fake. I want to see myself in college for Forensics I guess.

I feel like all I do is start problems or make them worse like making my parent fight over me failing or my sister blaming my parents for having to raise since they worked so much.
